# Lab 19.7: Data Quality Scans

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a data quality scan with automatic and custom rules, publish the score, and export results to BigQuery for alerting.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Write the rules.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; dq_rules.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
rules:
- column: order_id
  dimension: UNIQUENESS
  uniquenessExpectation: {}
- column: user_id
  dimension: COMPLETENESS
  nonNullExpectation: {}
- column: status
  dimension: VALIDITY
  setExpectation:
    values: ['Complete', 'Shipped', 'Processing', 'Returned', 'Cancelled']
- column: num_of_item
  dimension: VALIDITY
  rangeExpectation:
    minValue: '1'
    maxValue: '10'
- dimension: VALIDITY
  rowConditionExpectation:
    sqlExpression: "shipped_at IS NULL OR shipped_at &gt;= created_at"
- dimension: FRESHNESS
  tableConditionExpectation:
    sqlExpression: "MAX(created_at) &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)"
postScanActions:
  bigqueryExport:
    resultsTable: //bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID/datasets/lab19/tables/dq_results
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create and run the scan.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud dataplex datascans create data-quality orders-dq --location=us-central1 \
  --data-source-resource="//bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID/datasets/lab19/tables/orders" \
  --data-quality-spec-file=dq_rules.yaml
gcloud dataplex datascans run orders-dq --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Read the score.** Open `lab19.orders → Data quality`. See the overall score and the pass rate for each rule and dimension.

4. **[SQL] Query the exported results.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT job_start_time, rule_name, rule_dimension, rule_passed, rule_rows_passed_percent
FROM lab19.dq_results
ORDER BY job_start_time DESC, rule_passed;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Recommended rules.** Click **Create scan → Recommend rules** to get rules suggested from the data profile. Rules can also be saved as reusable templates for many tables.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Dimensions | Completeness, uniqueness, validity, freshness |
| Score | Shown on the table and catalog |
| Export | Results in `lab19.dq_results` |
| Alerting | Query or schedule checks on the results table |
